setup.intro: OLED Guard protects an OLED monitor or TV used with a PC from burn-in. Three quick steps and you're done.
setup.language.title: Language
setup.monitor.title: Which display is OLED?
setup.monitor.intro: Choose the display to protect. If you're not sure which is which, use Identify: a big number appears on each display for 3 seconds.
setup.monitor.none: No display found. Check the cable and try again.
setup.finish.title: What happens now
setup.finish.shift: The image moves by a few pixels every now and then, too little to notice.
setup.finish.dim: Small elements that stay still and bright (taskbar, icons, logos) are slowly dimmed and come back as soon as they change.
setup.finish.pause: Protection pauses by itself in games, full-screen video and protected windows.
setup.finish.emergency: If something goes wrong, {keys} closes OLED Guard at once.
setup.finish.autostart_desc: OLED Guard starts in the notification area when you sign in.
preview.identify: Preview: a number would appear on each display.
overlay.amplitude.desc: How many pixels the image moves at most. Wider protects more, but edges move more.
overlay.dwell.desc: A random time within this range.
overlay.transition.desc: The move happens slowly, one pixel at a time.
overlay.test.desc: Faster shifting for 30 seconds, to see it.
overlay.vig.hint: The edges stay still while the image shifts. They work while protection is active.
overlay.large.desc: Documents and pages that don't move (only with "Only logos on video").
overlay.strength.desc: How much still icons, labels and logos are dimmed.
overlay.ramp.desc: Brightness goes down slowly, without jumps.
overlay.excluded.desc: With these apps in the foreground, dimming is suspended.
overlay.act.never_hint: No window returns to normal by itself: they all dim the same way.
overlay.act.hint: The window you're using stays normal; when you leave it, the count starts again.
monitor.switch_hint: To change display, turn on another display's switch or the automatic choice.
monitor.brightness.desc: Dims the image in software. Works while protection is active.
monitor.ddc_hint: For contrast and the display's own panel care, use the display's menu: OLED Guard doesn't change the display's settings.
monitor.not_protected: Not protected. Turn on the switch to protect this display instead of {name}.
stats.wear.empty: No measurements yet: the map fills in while protection is active.
stats.wear.hint: Light reaching the panel × time, after dimming, brightness and edges. Paused time (games, full-screen video) isn't measured.
stats.uniformity: Uniformity {pct}: 100% = same wear on every position.
rule.always.title: Pause
rule.always.desc: Protection stops when the app is in the foreground
rule.always.explain: When this app is in the foreground, protection pauses, even if it's windowed.
rule.auto.title: Automatic
rule.auto.desc: Pause only when full screen or a game
rule.auto.explain: Protection pauses only if this app goes full screen or is an exclusive DirectX game.
rule.never.title: Never pause
rule.never.desc: Protection stays on even in full screen
rule.never.explain: Protection stays on even when this app is full screen (useful for video and browsers).
apps.auto.games.desc: Full-screen DirectX games, presentations, display not present.
apps.edit.when: When this app is in the foreground
apps.edit.no_dim: Don't dim while in the foreground
apps.edit.no_dim.desc: Suspends dimming of still areas (useful for graphics apps).
apps.edit.empty: Choose an app from the list to edit it.
apps.list.empty: No apps yet: add one below.
apps.edit.manual: Added by hand: it hasn't paused protection yet.
keys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys (Esc to cancel).
keys.emergency.desc: Closes OLED Guard at once. Works even if the interface is stuck.
keys.need_modifier: You need at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win.
settings.language.desc: Automatic follows the Windows language. Spanish, German and French are machine translations waiting for a review.
settings.start.desc: OLED Guard starts by itself when you sign in and stays in the notification area.
settings.away.after.desc: Minutes without mouse and keyboard, with a still screen.
settings.away.level.desc: Final brightness; the fade lasts 10 seconds.
settings.away.sub: when you're not at the PC
settings.away.toggle.desc: Back to normal at the first movement. A playing video doesn't trigger it.
settings.accent.desc: Switches, selections and status. The number is the contrast against the panel background.
settings.size.desc: Enlarges text, spacing and icons together.
settings.log.desc: The Detailed level is only for tracking down a problem.
settings.alert.threshold.desc: How much of the screen being still, bright and not dimmed starts the count.
settings.alert.after.desc: Minutes in a row above the threshold. At most one alert per hour.
settings.alert.desc: Only for still, bright areas that protection isn't already dimming.
settings.app_stats.desc: Foreground time of each app, for the Statistics page. It stays on the PC.
settings.clear.desc: Resets the chart, wear map, apps and streak (history.json).
windows.title: Windows settings for an OLED
windows.hint: Every change only happens when you click. The original value is saved and "Restore as before" puts it back.
advanced.dim_bright_threshold_pct.desc: From what brightness a still element gets dimmed (% of white).
advanced.dim_motion_fraction_pct.desc: How much the content around a logo must move to count as "video".
advanced.dim_recover_ms.desc: How long an area takes to return to normal when it changes.
advanced.pause_enter_delay_ms.desc: Wait before pausing (avoids pausing for a moment).
advanced.resume_delay_ms.desc: Wait before resuming after a game or a video.
advanced.title: Engine parameters
advanced.tearing.desc: Only with VRR (G-Sync/FreeSync) on: lowers the overlay latency.
advanced.hint: App settings, appearance and diagnostics are in Settings.

about.changes.1.0.0.5: Display page to choose the display to protect
about.intro: Protects an OLED display from burn-in: it shifts the image by a few pixels, slowly dims still and bright areas, and pauses by itself with games and full-screen video.
about.panel_care: Keep using your display's own panel care too (pixel refresh, and its pixel shift if it has one): OLED Guard adds to it, it doesn't replace it.
about.browser_video: Protected video inside a browser can't be detected: in full screen protection pauses by itself; in a window, use the manual pause or a rule for the browser.
about.webview2: Used to draw this window. BSD-style license from Microsoft (text in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
about.license.desc: OLED Guard is open source under the GPL-3.0 license.
notice.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
notice.diagnostics_failed: The diagnostics file couldn't be written. Details in the log.
advanced.diag.export.desc: Saves a text file in Documents with Windows version, GPUs, displays, configuration and the end of the log. Attach it to your report on GitHub.
advanced.diag.privacy: Read the file before sharing it: the configuration contains the names of the apps in your rules. Nothing is sent automatically.
